aboutText: Hire a Hubby Chelsea is your go-to team for reliable, professional handyman services throughout the Bayside area. With over 15 years of experience serving Chelsea and surrounding suburbs, we pride ourselves on quality workmanship, honest pricing and turning up when we say we will. From a leaky tap to a full kitchen renovation, no job is too big or too small for our skilled tradespeople.

servicesText: No matter the size of the job, Hire a Hubby Chelsea has the skills and experience to get it done right. We offer a wide range of handyman services tailored to Chelsea homeowners.

testimonials.text: Our deck was looking pretty sad after a few Melbourne winters. These guys sanded it back, re-stained the whole thing and it looks brand new. Great communication from start to finish and very fair pricing.

testimonials.text: We used Hire a Hubby for our kitchen renovation and couldn't be happier. They managed everything — plumbing, tiling, cabinetry — and the result exceeded our expectations. Absolute legends!
